# the fields, and reference it in index.qmd with

#     A short quote about using the hubverse.
hmsc:
  hub: West Nile Virus Forecasting Hub
  org:
    slug: cadph
    name: California Department of Public Health
  name: Dr. Héctor M. Sánchez C
  img: /includes/img/HMSC.png
  testimonial: |
    We wanted to launch the first West Nile Virus Forecasting
    Challenge in the state of California to support existing efforts in reducing
    disease prevalence. **The hubverse tools have been a crucial component in our
    setup** as they allow for standard submission formats and validations, which
    encourage participation and collaborations from external teams.
sjf:
  hub: Southern Hemisphere Severe Acute Respiratory Infection Forecast Hub
  org:
    slug: sjfox
    name: Northern Arizona University
  name: Dr. Spencer J Fox
  img: /includes/img/sjf.png
  testimonial: |
    Hubverse tools have been instrumental in enabling us to scale infectious disease forecasting globally, including to regions that have historically lacked access to real-time forecasts. Their standardized, flexible infrastructure makes it possible to rapidly deploy and coordinate forecasting efforts across many regions.
acefa:
  hub: Australia-Aotearoa Forecasting Hub
  org:
    slug: acefa
    name: Australia-Aotearoa Consortium for Epidemic Forecasting & Analytics
  name: Dr. Saras Windecker
  img: /includes/img/acefa_ppl.jpg
  testimonial: |
    The hubverse tools and team were instrumental in getting our hubs up and running. The materials provided a solid foundation for us to build upon, and were easily extendable to personalise the hubs to our unique data use cases. The team and broader community provide welcome support.
